patterns.note: A two-column grid layout is consistently used for displaying exhibition items, with each item featuring an image and minimal text details, creating a clean and organized content presentation.

The site employs a dramatic contrast in typography, featuring an extremely large, wide, uppercase sans-serif for the main branding element and a much smaller, clean sans-serif for all navigational and descriptive text.
The primary UI color scheme is strictly monochrome (black text on a white background), which allows the vibrant and diverse colors of the displayed artwork to be the sole focal point.
The prominent 'TRANEN' logo at the top of the page dynamically shrinks and repositions itself to the bottom of the page, acting as a footer, as the user scrolls down.
The minimalist top navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, providing persistent access to main sections while content scrolls beneath it.

technique_notes: The main branding element (logo) transitions from a large, prominent hero-like display at the top of the page to a smaller, fixed footer element at the bottom of the page as the user scrolls, creating a unique page-framing effect.
A minimalist, fixed navigation bar is positioned at the top of the viewport, ensuring key links are always accessible without obscuring content.

Content sections are presented in a clean, two-column grid, with each item consisting of an image and associated text, scrolling vertically beneath the sticky header and above the transforming footer.

design_tokens.type_scale: An extremely oversized, wide, uppercase sans-serif display font (~10x body) for the main logo, contrasted with small, understated sans-serif for navigation and content details.
design_tokens.spacing: airy; generous vertical spacing around the main logo and between content blocks, creating a sense of openness and allowing artwork to breathe.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the dynamic transformation of the main 'TRANEN' logo. It starts as an imposing, full-width hero element at the top of the page and smoothly shrinks and repositions itself to become a subtle, fixed footer at the bottom upon scroll, effectively framing the content in a unique and memorable way.
